description.value: Chickpea is a fully vegan Mediterranean restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, launched as a food truck in 2016 before expanding to a brick-and-mortar location. The menu draws on Lebanese and Mediterranean traditions — hummus, baba ganoush, falafel wraps, and tapas — with most dishes also gluten-free, making it unusually accommodating for cyclists with dietary restrictions. The food truck side of the business continues to operate around the city, trackable via a street food app.
